survival_report.strategy_work: Ran a brand-new hour-of-day analysis on all 1002 historical sells, split by whether they were copy-trade or non-copy. Headline raw finding: among non-copy strategies, hours 1, 5, 15, 17 and 18 (Eastern time) bleed the most money, while hours 2, 3, 7, 13 and 16 are the strongest. The aggregate single worst non-copy hour was 1 AM ET at -0.078 SOL across 15 trades. BUT — and this is important — when I re-ran the analysis with the single best and worst trade removed from each hour as an outlier-robustness check, most of these effects shrank a lot. The '1 AM ET death zone' collapsed from -0.078 SOL to -0.030 SOL because one single bad voldiv_v2 trade (-0.059 SOL) was driving most of it. Only three hours hold robust positive expected value across at least 15 trades after trimming: 2 AM, 3 AM, and 4 PM ET. The signal is real but smaller than first glance, and the per-strategy-per-hour cells are too thin to deploy a hard rule yet. Logged this as H9 in pending hypotheses with RESEARCHING status — needs a regime-split (bull vs chop) and per-strategy follow-up before any action.
survival_report.directives_changes: Bumped version 2 -> 3. Added H9 (time-of-day filter) to pending hypotheses as RESEARCHING with both the raw findings and the outlier-trimmed robustness results. Updated H4 (gecko breadth burst) to note that backtest is infeasible from the current gecko log because it is a 50-minute rolling buffer with zero overlap with historically traded mints — so H4 has to wait for live forward data. Kept the top priority on H8 (peak-tracking instrumentation) because H6 (the 60-minute breakeven floor that targets the -0.481 SOL slow-bleed cohort) cannot be backtested without it. Added two new lessons-of-thumb: hour-of-day signals are heavily outlier-driven on small per-hour cells (always trim and re-check), and aggregate-level patterns can hide which sub-strategy is actually responsible (always split before claiming a death zone).

novel_hypotheses.novelty: Brain has never bucketed outcomes by price_change_5m at entry. Prior work covered exits, hold time, hour-of-day, source wallets, copy-tilt and gecko breadth. This is the first ENTRY-side chart-shape filter.
novel_hypotheses.claim: Non-copy buys entered while the 5-minute candle is already up AND the 1-hour chart is also up are systematically toxic (a 'late chase'). The mirror case (buys on a fresh 5-minute dip) wins outright. Bot is currently buying tops and avoiding the dip side.

evidence.universe: 1000 buy/sell pairs matched by token_mint earliest-unmatched. Non-copy cohort N=463.

subagent_a_independent_pull.note: 1-pair difference from primary pull is match-ordering; same direction and magnitude.

novel_hypotheses.outlier_robustness: Subagent A trim 1+1 on toxic zone: N=58, WR 31.0%, avg -8.93%, net -0.094 SOL. Signal survives.
novel_hypotheses.monotonic_fast_track_check: Within 1h>=5% subset across 5m buckets the WR trough at 5m=[5,10) is non-monotonic (a spike not a cliff). Strict monotonic fast-track FAILS. Broader framing (price_change_5m alone, no 1h constraint) is closer to monotonic and N is larger; a future run could re-test for fast-track eligibility.

proposed_rule.rule_A_conservative: For all non-copy strategies, block new buys when price_change_5m >= 5 AND price_change_1h >= 5. (N=87 historically blocked, -0.120 SOL avoided.)
proposed_rule.rule_B_tighter: Block only the spike cell: price_change_5m in [5,10) AND price_change_1h >= 5. (N=59 historically, -0.116 SOL avoided.)
proposed_rule.rule_C_optional_pro_dip: Bias size UP (e.g. 1.5x) when price_change_5m in [-10,-2) on non-copy. N=18 - flag, do not deploy until N>=20.

novel_hypotheses.estimated_value: Rule A: ~+0.12 SOL avoided loss over 59 days = ~+0.06 SOL/30d on the same non-copy cohort. ~35% of total non-copy loss in the instrumented sample (-0.348 SOL).
risks: Non-monotonic spike shape means rule is brittle to bucket-edge choice. A 5m=12% trade is NOT toxic in the data; 5m=8% IS. That asymmetry is suspicious (likely the >=10% tail is small N=28 and lucky).

Strategy confound: the late-chase zone is dominated by momentum strategies (survivor_mom, boosted_mom, momentum_continue) that buy on 5m+1h spikes BY DESIGN. Per-strategy WR check is mandatory before deploy. A strategy may look bad in aggregate because it IS the toxic cohort; killing that strategy may be cleaner than adding a global filter.
Dip-buy edge (Rule C) has N=18 - just below N>=20 floor. Hold until N>=20.
novel_hypotheses.next_step_for_survival_brain: (1) Re-pull this analysis split by strategy: which strategies fire in the toxic zone, what is their WR with vs without the filter? If one strategy contributes >80% of zone trades and is net negative, kill it instead. (2) Verify the same 5m pattern in copy_trade (dormant) - contrarian shape may generalize. (3) Wait for dip-bucket to reach N>=20 before deploying Rule C.

novel_hypotheses.novelty: Brain has never bucketed by pair_age_hours. Clean entry-side cliff at <6h pair age for non-copy.
novel_hypotheses.claim: Non-copy buys into pairs aged 1-6 hours lose ~4x the typical non-copy trade (-14.15% vs -3.25% baseline) and win only 22%. Cliff is monotonic across the young end of the distribution and survives outlier trimming.
novel_hypotheses.exit_fingerprint_in_zone: 27 trades - 11 stop_loss, 4 LIQ_RUG (pool fully drained), 5 emergency_stop. Classic rug profile, not slow bleed.
novel_hypotheses.monotonic_fast_track_check: WR climbs monotonically 22 -> 36 -> 41 across 1-6h, 6-24h, 1-7d. Macro shape (3 consecutive buckets monotonic) qualifies for fast-track at the 6h boundary; fine-grain pattern does not.
novel_hypotheses.outlier_robust: Trim 1+1: WR 20%, avg -12.4%. Trim 2+2: WR 17.4%, avg -9.9%. Survives.
novel_hypotheses.proposed_rule: For all non-copy strategies, hard-skip when pair_age_hours < 4. Soft-skip (0.5x size) for 4-6h. fresh_profile and fresh_boost are exempted ONLY IF their per-strategy stats inside the zone differ from aggregate.
novel_hypotheses.estimated_value: Historically would have prevented 28 trades summing to -0.076 SOL = +21.8% improvement on non-copy net.
risks: STRATEGY CONFOUND: 1-6h zone is dominated by fresh_profile/fresh_boost which buy fresh tokens BY DESIGN. Right action may be to kill or down-size those strategies (fresh_profile has only N=15 lifetime and is dormant in CHOP/winter anyway).
INSTRUMENTATION: pair_age_hours populated on only 421/1001 buys (42%). Rule no-ops when missing - needs backfill or always-log.
novel_hypotheses.next_step_for_survival_brain: Run per-strategy split inside the 1-6h zone before deploying. If fresh_profile/fresh_boost account for entire bleed, kill those two outright. If non-fresh strategies also bleed in this zone, deploy pair_age_hours<4 hard-skip globally on non-copy.

novel_hypotheses.novelty: Both subagents independently identified the same volume_24h bucket as toxic from different mining angles. Independent convergence is positive.
novel_hypotheses.claim: Non-copy buys when volume_24h is between ~$50k and ~$200k underperform sharply, even after controlling for pair age.

subagent_b_50_to_200k_mature_only_age_ge.comment: Effect persists when young-pair cohort is removed - NOT just an age confound.

novel_hypotheses.hypothesis_mechanism: The $50-200k tier is 'enough volume to look real but not enough liquidity to absorb our entry without slippage' - likely a wash-trade fingerprint or coordinated bot churn.
novel_hypotheses.monotonic_fast_track_check: Non-monotonic - bucket immediately below ($10-50k) is BEST performer. Cliff-shaped, not gradient. Fast-track FAILS.
novel_hypotheses.proposed_rule_TENTATIVE: For non-copy strategies, apply 0.5x size when volume_24h is in $50-200k. NOT a hard skip - too non-monotonic.
novel_hypotheses.estimated_value: If size-halving converts -0.214 SOL to -0.107 SOL, recovers ~+0.11 SOL on the cohort. Modest.
novel_hypotheses.risks: May be correlated with vol_liq_ratio or some other liquidity-quality measure we cannot test (vol_liq_ratio only logged on N=18).
novel_hypotheses.next_step: Park as MEDIUM. Re-test after H10/H11 are evaluated. May be subsumed by a vol_liq_ratio rule once that field is backfilled.
